purpose: Wave-4 Archaeology permanent infrastructure and monolith relic powers still missing as first-class rows: official dig-site hubs (Stormguard, Warforge, Senntisten, Daemonheim, Infernal Source), Imcando mattock, master outfit claim, monolith energy/loadout ladder, and high-value relic powers (Pharm Ecology, Inspire Awe/Love/Effort, Pouch Protector, Nexus Mod, Unexpected Diplomacy, Endurance, Deathless, Slayer Introspection, Spirit Weaver, Abyssal Link). Complements invention-arch and guild packs without re-emitting already-indexed dig sites (Kharid-et, Everlight, Orthen, Moonrise) or always-adze / death-note / sticky-fingers / inspire-genius / flow-state / divine-conversion.

policy.region_rule: region_hint is primary geography. Dig-site map for this pack (wiki Equilibrium League badges + pack override): Warforge=kandarin, Stormguard=kandarin, Senntisten=misthalin, Daemonheim=forinthry (wiki Wilderness badge = Forinthry in this planner), Infernal Source=forinthry (pack map; wiki surface hotspots tag Misthalin — Source sits under Wilderness Crater). Never put multi-region/cross-region/global tokens in region_hint.
policy.duplicate_guard: SKIP already first-class: desert:kharid-et-dig-site, morytania:everlight-dig-site, anachronia:orthen-dig-site, havenhythe:moonrise-dig-site, misthalin:archaeology-guild-shop, misthalin:archaeology-campus-hub, misthalin:guildmaster-qualification, misthalin:archaeology-research, misthalin:archaeology-collectors, cross-region:mattock-of-time-and-space, asgarnia:inspire-genius-relic, anachronia:always-adze-relic, anachronia:death-note-relic, anachronia:flow-state-relic, morytania:sticky-fingers-relic, asgarnia:divine-conversion-relic, kandarin:warforge-dig-site-boundary (boundary note only — this file adds the full dig-site hub). NOTE: research already has misthalin:infernal-source-dig-site — this pack emits forinthry:infernal-source-dig-site per dig-site map override (Source under Wilderness Crater / Forinthry pressure).
policy.no_trade_rule: Ironman permanent dig-site access, mattock craft, outfit claim, monolith energy capacity, and relic powers that change skilling/combat QoL.
policy.rate_rule: No invented XP/hour. Unlock state, costs, energy, and effects only.
policy.rs3_terminology: Relic powers are Archaeology monolith powers — distinct from Equilibrium League Relics. Mattock precision/focus are Archaeology tool stats.
